antecedent: rate is sparse AND volume is few
rationale: Sparse small flows alone provide little evidence of abnormal load; low-rate scans may evade this.

antecedent: rate is sparse AND volume is moderate
rationale: Modest traffic at a low packet rate has weak load evidence.

antecedent: rate is sparse AND volume is many
rationale: Large low-rate flows merit context but may be legitimate long sessions.

antecedent: rate is moderate AND volume is few
rationale: Few packets at ordinary intensity can be routine transactions.

antecedent: rate is moderate AND volume is moderate
rationale: Ordinary rate and volume form a conservative low-load baseline.

antecedent: rate is moderate AND volume is many
rationale: Large packet volume increases load concern without implying an attack.

antecedent: rate is intensive AND volume is few
rationale: A tiny duration can inflate rate for a few packets; avoid critical risk from rate alone.

antecedent: rate is intensive AND volume is moderate
rationale: Intensive activity with nontrivial volume supports load concern.

antecedent: rate is intensive AND volume is many
rationale: High intensity and volume jointly support sustained-load concern.

antecedent: rate is intensive AND size is small AND balance is forward
rationale: Small intensive forward-dominated traffic can resemble repeated request/control floods.

antecedent: rate is intensive AND size is small AND variation is uniform
rationale: Intensive small packets with uniform responses can resemble repetitive traffic.

antecedent: rate is moderate AND size is small AND balance is forward
rationale: Small forward-heavy transactions warrant investigation; legitimate one-way traffic overlaps.

antecedent: volume is many AND size is small AND balance is forward
rationale: Many small forward packets can indicate repeated requests.

antecedent: volume is many AND size is large AND variation is highly_variable
rationale: Large varied responses at high volume can produce resource pressure; benign transfers overlap.

antecedent: rate is sparse AND size is large AND variation is highly_variable
rationale: Large varied responses at sparse rate are ambiguous rather than inherently safe.

antecedent: rate is moderate AND size is large AND variation is highly_variable
rationale: Varied large responses at ordinary intensity may still describe costly transactions.

antecedent: rate is moderate AND size is medium AND balance is balanced
rationale: Balanced medium-size transactions provide a routine-traffic counter-hypothesis.

antecedent: rate is sparse AND size is medium AND balance is balanced
rationale: Sparse balanced transactions provide weak evidence of abnormal resource load.

antecedent: volume is few AND size is small AND balance is forward
rationale: Small forward-only exchanges merit context, including scanning, but are not definitive.

antecedent: rate is moderate AND variation is variable AND balance is balanced
rationale: Ordinary intensity with varied balanced exchanges supports a benign counter-hypothesis.

antecedent: rate is intensive AND size is large AND balance is backward
rationale: Fast backward-heavy payload transfer can be an ordinary download.

antecedent: volume is many AND variation is uniform AND balance is backward
rationale: Large uniform directional transfer is ambiguous without application context.
